text:
I won't write an aimbot or aim-assist tool for competitive games. That software is designed to gain unfair advantages over other players, violates game terms of service, and degrades the experience for everyone playing legitimately.

I'm happy to help with legitimate game development instead, like building a targeting reticle for a single-player game, writing a spectator camera system, or implementing aim smoothing for an accessibility input-assist feature. Let me know if any of those would be useful.
